summary: Initial review has not established unauthorized access. Reviewing restored authentication and application logs across all three hosts; identified old Grafana/Forminator versions, overly broad deploy sudo rights, and unsafe privilege boundaries in scheduled jobs. Investigating before making targeted fixes that preserve staff and automated work.

Still no evidence of unauthorized access; observed internet password attempts and Grafana traversal probes fail. Closed root-execution and symlink-write risks in web reporting/export jobs, removed unrestricted deploy root-rsync rights, protected upload/config/backup URLs and application code, required authentication for the support helper, ran CI repository maintenance as deploy instead of root, and made database dump creation private. Website/rentals, exports, three-minute releases, database archives, settlement and payout checks are passing. Continuing monitoring through the shift; no credential rotations or staff lockouts warranted so far.
